name: Axe of the Ancestors
description: A dwarven battleaxe reforged in the light of the geode cache. Clan runes burn faintly along the haft, and in a dwarf's hands it feels like it remembers every battle it has seen.
notes: Versatile: 1d10 damage with an empty off hand.
Dwarves: Clan's Endurance, +2 Constitution and +2 Resolve while wielded.
Reward from The Axe of the Ancestors.
